Publish.LongDescription:
# English
# RouteFilter
RouteFilter gives Cities: Skylines II players precise control over which vehicle assets may use a selected road or rail node or an entire network segment.
## Main features
* Restrict exact road, tram, train, subway, carriage, trailer, and outside-traffic assets. * Keep an independent forbidden list on every selected node or segment. * Filter the catalog automatically for the selected road or rail target. * Search assets and inspect maximum speed, acceleration, and braking. * Group recognized engines and trailers while retaining individual control. * Request a new route through the native pathfinder when a matching vehicle approaches. * Stop matching vehicles when a fixed route has no valid alternative. * Save restrictions with the city and switch automatically between English and Simplified Chinese.
## Basic use
Open the RouteFilter panel from the top-left toolbar or press Ctrl+Shift+N.
Select **Node** or **Segment**, left-click a network target, choose the assets that should be forbidden, then apply the list to the selected target. Right-click cancels target selection.
Bulk allow/forbid actions edit only the pending list. They do not change the map until the explicit **Apply** button is pressed.
## Important notes
Technical prefab names may not have localized display names.
Rebuilding a network segment can replace its game entity and remove restrictions attached to the original.
RouteFilter cannot redraw a fixed public-transport line; when no valid detour exists, the affected vehicle stops and may retry.
## Support, discussion, and issue reports
For general discussion, usage questions, feedback, and community support, you can use the following channels:
* **Paradox Forum:** [https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/)
* **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD](https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD)
For reproducible bugs, performance issues, compatibility problems, and feature requests, please use the GitHub issue tracker whenever possible:
* **GitHub Issues:** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues)
Source code, releases, and documentation are available on GitHub:
* **GitHub Repository:** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter)
General questions and informal feedback are welcome on the Paradox Forum or Discord. GitHub Issues are preferred for problems that need to be tracked, reproduced, or fixed.
# 中文
# RouteFilter
RouteFilter 为《都市天际线 II》玩家提供了精细控制能力，可指定哪些车辆资产允许使用选定的道路或铁路节点，或者整个路段。
## 主要功能
* 精确限制特定的道路、有轨电车、火车、地铁、客运车厢、拖车以及外部交通资产。 * 在每个选定的节点或路段上维护独立的禁止列表。 * 根据所选道路或铁路目标，自动筛选资产目录。 * 搜索资产并查看其最高速度、加速度和制动性能。 * 将识别的发动机与拖车分组，同时保留对单个车辆的独立控制。 * 当匹配的车辆接近时，通过游戏原生路径查找器请求新路线。 * 当固定路线无有效替代路径时，令匹配车辆停止行驶。 * 限制规则随城市存档保存，并支持英文和简体中文自动切换。
## 基本使用方法
从左上角工具栏打开 RouteFilter 面板，或按快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+N。
选择 **“节点”** 或 **“路段”**，左键单击道路/铁路目标，然后勾选需要禁止的资产，最后点击 **“应用”** 按钮将列表生效于所选目标。右键单击可取消目标选择。
批量允许/禁止操作仅修改待处理的列表；在显式点击 **“应用”** 按钮之前，不会对地图造成任何更改。
## 重要说明
技术性预制件名称可能没有本地化显示名称。
重建某一路段可能会替换其游戏实体，从而导致附加到原始路段上的限制被移除。
RouteFilter 无法重新绘制固定的公共交通线路；当不存在有效绕行路线时，受影响的车辆会停止并可能反复尝试。
## 支持、讨论与问题反馈
对于一般讨论、使用问题、体验反馈以及社区交流，可以使用以下渠道：
* **Paradox Forum：** [https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/)
* **Discord：** [https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD](https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD)
对于能够稳定复现的 Bug、性能问题、兼容性问题以及功能建议，建议优先使用 GitHub Issue 追踪器：
* **GitHub Issues：** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues)
源代码、发布版本及文档可在 GitHub 查看：
* **GitHub 仓库：** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter)
一般问题和非正式反馈可以直接在 Paradox Forum 或 Discord 中交流；对于需要持续跟踪、复现和修复的问题，建议使用 GitHub Issues。
Publish.ChangeLog:
## RouteFilter 1.0.4
- Fixed the occasionally incomplete vehicle catalog: it now rebuilds once after each save finishes loading and whenever vehicle prefabs or content actually change, so late-loading modded assets (for example CR400AF trains) are no longer missing. Opening the panel never triggers a rebuild. - The manual refresh button now uses a proper icon instead of a font glyph that rendered as a box. - The panel is taller and adapts to the screen size and UI scale, showing more asset rows while staying clear of the game toolbar. - The tool no longer raycasts or touches the vanilla tool selection while inactive. - Enforcement scanning moved to a parallel Burst job, the pathfinding pipeline is skipped while no detour is active, restriction badges are drawn by one batched job, and index rebuilds reuse their allocations.
